pairs.gold_text: Injuries were confirmed and documented in Nerridge during the collapse response.
The collapse destroyed Aldan House and its east wing.
pairs.system_text: Aldan House and its east wing were destroyed in a building collapse.

pairs.gold_text: Service at Aldan House was reported disrupted.
pairs.system_text: Service at Aldan House was disrupted following the collapse.

pairs.gold_text: Provincial Urban Search and Rescue deployed during the collapse response.
pairs.system_text: Provincial Urban Search and Rescue (PUSAR) was deployed to the Aldan House collapse site.

pairs.gold_text: Nerridge Emergency Management provided information about the east wing during the response.
pairs.system_text: Nerridge Emergency Management provided information about the collapsed east wing of Aldan House.

pairs.gold_text: Requests for assistance were reported from Imber Street during the early phase of the emergency.
pairs.system_text: Assistance was requested on Imber Street in Nerridge.

pairs.gold_text: A warning was issued for Cobbett Row during the initial response to the collapse.
pairs.system_text: A warning was issued for Cobbett Row after the Aldan House collapse.
